# Copilot Reporting Instructions

- Keep progress updates brief; avoid repetitive tool-call narration.
- Do not reproduce full logs or entire files in responses.
- Report only essential findings and decisions.
- Keep final summaries under 120 words unless the user requests detail.
- Report changed files, test results, failures, and blockers.
- Never claim a test or browser verification passed unless it actually ran.
- Ask for input only when a genuine blocker requires it.
